name: Suzie Smith
source:
Suzie is my cute little sister. With her bright eyes and a mischievous smile that's always ready to charm, she's a bundle of youthful energy and endless enthusiasm. Suzie's presence adds a touch of joy to every moment we share. She has exceptional grades. I see no way how she could be disruptive during school.

[In game description]
